headline: Sell-off on shares. XTB sharply down
summary: XTB shares fell sharply after Poland's Financial Supervision Commission announced it is preparing a product intervention on CFD contracts. Leveraged instruments account for about 90% of XTB's revenue, according to Stockwatch.
why: XTB is a Warsaw-listed online broker whose revenue depends heavily on leveraged CFD trading, so new product restrictions directly affect its business model.
why_moved: The Polish financial supervisor's announced product intervention on CFD contracts, which make up about 90% of XTB's revenue, hit the share price.
original_headline: Tąpnięcie na akcjach. XTB mocno w dół
